content: Since we have used a pre-trained multilingual BERT model, the same approach is likely to work for other languages just by providing some labelled training data. Further, this is the simplest fine-tuning that can be performed based on BERT. More sophisticated fine-tuning layers could help improve the results. For example, it could be expected that a CRF layer helped enforce better BIO tagging sequence predictions. Precisely, mao2019hadoken participated in the MEDDOCAN competition using a BERT+CRF architecture, but their reported scores are about 3 points lower than our implementation. From the description of their work, it is unclear what the source of this score difference could be.
